summary_1line: A mother and daughter each argue to sacrifice themselves to the Rakshasa to save the father and family, expressing ideals of duty and self‑sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Brahmana and his wife cling to each other in silent tears after her plea to be sacrificed to the Rakshasa.
The young daughter stands before her grieving parents and offers herself as the sacrifice to save the family.
